overview: The City Council and Community Development Board met in a joint hearing to deliberate on zoning amendments for the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District. Both bodies reached a consensus on building heights and student housing definitions, voting to close the public hearing and move toward final technical drafting.

items.title: Presentation on Proposed Zoning Updates
items.summary: Director Alicia Hunt presented updates from the Community Development Board regarding revised parking requirements and a comprehensive definition for 'Purpose-Built Student Housing.'

items.title: Discussion of Student Housing Definition and Management
items.summary: The boards reviewed proposed standards for private dormitories, including a minimum of 150 beds, on-site professional management, and an annual certificate of occupancy renewal process.

items.title: Innes Associates Presentation on Heights and Boundaries
items.summary: The consultants presented three height and boundary scenarios for each sub-district (BA1, BA2, and BA3) along with shadow studies to illustrate impacts on neighboring residential properties.

items.title: Public Hearing
items.summary: Residents expressed concerns over excessive heights and potential traffic congestion, while property owners and developers argued for flexible density and high-density student housing to relieve pressure on the existing housing stock.

items.title: Height Determination for Sub-District BA1
items.summary: The Council and the Board approved Option A, setting the maximum height at three base stories with a one-story incentive.

items.title: Height Determination for Sub-District BA2
items.summary: Approved Option C, which allows four base stories with a three-story incentive in the center corridor and includes an amended minimum six-foot setback on Winchester Street.

items.title: Height Determination for Sub-District BA3
items.summary: Approved Option A, establishing a five-story base with a two-story incentive to provide a transition from nearby ten-story university structures.

items.title: Direction on Affordability Incentives and Boundaries
items.summary: The bodies approved a request to fix technical mathematical errors in the affordability incentive table and voted to maintain the original district boundaries for BA1.

items.title: Approval of Purpose-Built Student Housing Standards
items.summary: Approved the definition and use standards for student housing, with a directive for staff to refine requirements for management plan interactions with academic institutions.

items.title: Closure of the Public Hearing
items.summary: Both bodies voted to close the public hearing, noting that major policy decisions were settled and delegating final document cleanup to the Planning Department for an August review.
